selection_rule: Before evaluating returns: top 15 SPY company weights plus top four per GICS sector; exact SEC NYSE/Nasdaq identities; one share class per CIK. Current membership creates survivorship bias in retrospective diagnostics. This is a finite experimental US-listed large-cap universe, not a screen of all US stocks.
return_basis: Completed provider split-adjusted price closes, excluding cash dividends; USD prices divided by dated ECB USD per EUR reference rates. No backfill before inception.
